phase0_answers.q1_data_sources: Nuolja SITES 2024 5-var hourly CSV (8784h), Clear-sky GHI & terrain decomposition CSV (8784h), AROME 21x21 NWP cache.
phase0_answers.q4_nwp_forecast_data: MEPS/AROME 21x21 spatial grid for 700hPa wind, cloud cover, 2m temp, 2m RH, LWP, IWP.
phase0_answers.q7_nwp_causal_validity: CONDITIONAL (Valid at MPC origin t iff t_issue <= t).
phase0_answers.q10_causal_features: Lookback statistics (mean, std, slope, diff over 1h-24h), astronomical clear-sky GHI, terrain obstruction, calendar variables, and NWP features with t_issue <= t.
phase0_answers.q11_rejected_features: Future observations, future-origin NWP predictions, satellite frames without issue-time provenance, zero-padded/interpolated future vectors.
phase0_answers.q12_missing_resources: Hourly intra-day NWP issue runs (06:00, 12:00, 18:00 UTC) in 2024 archive.
phase0_answers.q13_feasible_architectures: 1) Causal Baseline Engine (Persistence/Clear-sky k_t), 2) Causal Ridge/HistGradientBoosting/XGBoost, 3) Causal PyTorch Multi-Head Neural Net.
phase0_answers.q15_reproducibility_requirements: Complete 34-item immutable package, serialized model (.joblib/.pt), SHA-256 hashes, 4 JSON manifests, ENVIRONMENT.json, REPRODUCTION_INSTRUCTIONS.md, independent replay verification.
phase0_answers.q16_24h_rolling_forecast_causal: YES (CONDITIONAL: Feasible for clear-sky, ARX, and NWP models using lead-time shifted issue runs).
phase0_answers.q17_blockers: Sparse NWP issue times (00:00 UTC only) requiring lead-time adjustment for intra-day origins.
phase0_answers.q19_unverified_assumptions: Forecast skill degradation when using 00:00 UTC NWP forecasts for late intra-day origins (t=18:00 UTC).
